blocks.text:
commit():  parseManagedSessionEvent(value)        // PR: linear now
           const encoded = events.map((event) => JSON.stringify(event));   // walks every path
           ... byteLength(line) > maxEventBytes -> refuse                  // reached only after the walk

V8 keeps walking after the string-length limit trips and throws only at the end:
cost doubles per level (N=26 5.6 s, N=28 21.3 s) -> N=40 ~ 21 s x 2^12 ~ one day of a blocked event loop.

The PR moves the exponential walk from assertJsonValue into commit(). For N >= ~27 the append the R4-1 thread describes still blocks the process, and below that it fails as an untyped RangeError after seconds and ~1 GB RSS instead of a ManagedSessionRecordError.

Candidate (attached patch): the memo also carries a lower bound on the expanded JSON size; a subgraph that shares references and expands past maxTransactionBytes (8 MiB) is refused during validation, before stringify. Trees (everything parsed from text) are never held to it.

title: Shared-reference depth bound is one level stricter than the record it serializes to
subtitle: target = { first: chain, shell: { second: chain } } · chain of L objects ending in null · second path's deepest object at depth 4 + L · maxJsonDepth = 64

cells: L = 60 shared, same object on both paths (deepest 64)

blocks.text:
noteChild(): a primitive child counts as height 1, so {nested: null} stores height 2 and a chain of 60 stores 61.
memo hit at depth 5: 5 + 61 - 1 = 65 > 64 -> reject, although the deepest object sits at 64 (the limit).

M11 'primitive height 0' (exact object depth) is KILLED by the PR's own 60-chain assertion:
the new test pins the stricter behaviour (triage said it could not tell the two semantics apart).
Candidate: primitive height 0, chain 60 -> 61, plus 'chain 60 shared is accepted'  -> 85/85;
chain 61 still kills 'memo skips the depth check' and 'primitive height 1'.

Fail-closed and it needs a >= 60-deep shared payload, so it is not blocking on its own. But it is a PR-introduced difference from main, the description calls the accounting exact, and the fix is two lines.
